Attach Census tissue to a cellNexus metadata query.

Source: R/annotate_cell_nexus.R
join_census_tissue.Rd

get_metadata() does not carry tissue or disease. This registers the Census observation table for census_version on the same DuckDB connection and left-joins tissue, disease, sex, and the other Census columns used downstream, on observation_joinid and dataset_id.

Usage

join_census_tissue(metadata, census_version = "2024-07-01")

Arguments

metadata

A lazy metadata table from get_metadata().

census_version

Census snapshot. cellNexus uses 2024-07-01; match this to the atlas you queried.

Value

metadata, with the Census columns attached.

Details

Call this after the study and cell-type filters, and before annotate_cell_nexus().
